SEARCH
Module awtzero
Package awtzero

Class Window

java.lang.Object
awtzero.Window
public class Window extends Object
Represents a window with a drawable screen area, keyboard input handling, and a game loop for updating and rendering.

Composits Frame to create a windowed application.

    • setOnUpdate

      public void setOnUpdate(Runnable onUpdate)
      Set the onUpdate function which handles updating (of variables, positions, etc.)

      The function is called every frame before drawing

      The function can either be a lambda or a method reference

      Parameters:
      onUpdate - the function to handle updation

    • setTargetFPS

    • startGameLoop

      public void startGameLoop()
      Starts the game loop

      The game loop repeatedly calls the onUpdate and onDraw functions at the target FPS

      The game loop updations and draws run in a separate thread
